row.answer: Shen is a tank who uses a taunting dash and empowered attacks with bonus magic damage based on the target's maximum health. He protects allies by blocking basic attacks and can shield a distant ally before teleporting to them.
row.counterplay: Avoid his dash and the path between Shen and his blade; account for his arrival when committing onto an ally.

row.answer: Stand United shields an allied champion anywhere on the map while Shen channels, then teleports Shen and his Spirit Blade to that ally if the channel completes.
